definition: The Baseline Personnel Security Standard is a UK government framework for basic employment screening of individuals with access to government assets.
entry_text: The Baseline Personnel Security Standard is a UK government framework for basic employment screening of individuals with access to government assets.
example: A recruiter documents completion of the required baseline checks before a new staff member begins work.
label: Baseline Personnel Security Standard
sense_note: This is a baseline screening framework, not a national security clearance.
